datasetDef: X: 60 region evidence-corpus embeddings (region_evidence_pca_v1, corpus ac4d97d111e2 — regions WITH indexed evidence only, a selection biased toward well-studied regions); Y: the same 60 regions' NeuroQuery meta-map profiles across 19 disorders, column-z-scored, PCA to 8. Rows include left/right homolog pairs (near-duplicates in both views), so the permutation null moves homolog pairs as blocks with random within-pair flips; singletons permute among singletons. A naive row shuffle understates the null and inflates significance. Both views derive from the research literature — alignment measures curation/automated-mining consistency, NOT independent biological validation.
preprocessing: X used as built (log1p counts -> z-score -> PCA-8). Y: per-disorder z-score across regions -> PCA-8 (seed 42).
model: CCA, 3 components (scikit-learn); significance by 1000 homolog-block permutations of Y (refit per permutation, per-component p = (1+#perm>=observed)/(1+N)). No deflation across components — p-values for components >= 2 are approximate; significance claims rest on component 1.
